title: Konkoye protest against Hongxing mining company
reason: The opened report’s stated demand was that the private mining company leave because of environmental degradation. No demand directed to Guinea’s own government/state policy is documented. Security forces’ presence and an alleged shooting do not themselves establish a state-target demand. Crowd size is also unreported.
notes: Search results on Anadolu and BHRRC (S005-S007) appear to repeat or cite Guineenews/AFP and are not independent body evidence; the exclusion is based on the opened Guineenews report. Preserve open question whether participants also sought state environmental enforcement.
